svg.title: Frozen-plant control loop
svg.desc: A feedback episode reads hidden states and frozen-head predictions without labels. Measurements enter a conditioned observer and a supported action policy. Ordinary actions run the registered native or inserted site; A8 and A9 directly restore a reference state. Both paths update the hidden state for the next depth. Observer and consequence models are fitted offline and remain fixed. Global comparator admission is a separate workflow.

text.tspan: A control loop around frozen message passing
Feedback changes transport or restores a state. Predictor and controller parameters stay fixed.
FROZEN PREDICTOR · one complete graph per episode
It is row-normalized; native weights stay fixed.
LABEL-FREE FEEDBACK · no labels enter this loop
Open-loop schedules keep their plan. Global admission and comparator return are separate decisions.
